source: A Blaze in the Dark
A Brief Respite
A Busca
A Campanha Lollo está enfrentando uma crise inesperada! Para salvar a carreira do Maji e manter esses convenientes serviços funcionando, ajude-o a verificar a confiabilidade da Campanha Lollo!
target: 嗚嗚系列便利企劃竟迎來危機，為了馬計的職業生涯，也為了你能繼續享受省心的服務，幫助他驗證「嗚嗚企劃」的可靠性吧！

source: A Canção do Gelo e do Aço
A Canção dos Laços Invisíveis
A Chill Day Out
A Corrida Tochestrela deixa você animado. Você decide compartilhar essa alegria com Haley, que se dedicou de corpo e alma ao evento.
target: 享受過星炬競速賽後你感到心滿意足，想把當下的心情分享給為賽事盡心盡力的惠勒。

source: A Corrida Tochestrela está de volta! Procure Haley para mais detalhes e prepare-se para uma nova rodada de corridas emocionantes!
target: 星炬競速賽又開賽了！去找惠勒了解一下情況，開始新一次的馳騁吧！

source: A Crise na Oficina Celeste chegou ao fim, e Danjin encontrou seu caminho. É uma trilha traiçoeira, mas com a luz pulsando em seu pingente de jade e suas palavras em seu coração, ela não teme mais o que vem pela frente.
target: 懸天構危機已經解除，丹瑾也尋得未來的方向，儘管道阻且長，但有明玉的光芒，有你的話語，她已不畏前行。

source: A Diggy Duggy sends you a request, hoping you'll help find the treasure it once buried with its young master.
target: 鏟子叔叔發來委託，希望你能幫忙它找出自己和小主人以前共同埋好的寶藏。

source: A Donzela deixou a torre sem se despedir. Siga sua trilha até a terra da glória.
target: 高塔中的聖女不告而別，追逐著她留下的痕跡，前往那被榮光照耀之地吧。

source: A Equipe de Resgate de Gatinhos encontrou dificuldades durante o processo de resgate de gatos. Ajude a equipe e leve o gato de rua para Xiaoju.
target: 貓咪救援隊在救貓過程中遇到了困難，請協助救援人員拯救流浪貓，並將貓咪交給小橘撫養吧。

source: A Estrela Sombria
A Faculdade Rabelle parece estar recrutando participantes para um curso de combate virtual. Vá até a plataforma de treinamento para saber mais.
target: 拉貝爾學部似乎在募集虛擬作戰課程的參與者，去訓練平台看看情況吧。

source: A Feira Enluarada começou como esperado. Mantenha a popularidade.
target: 宵月會順利開幕，請讓它的熱度繼續保持下去。

source: A Fissura Selada mostra poucos sinais de contaminação de Matéria do Vazio, mas um Solispírito desorientado, Bada, está preso no gelo e precisa urgentemente de resgate.
target: 封存地並無太多虛質汙染的痕跡，但迷糊的日靈巴達被困在冰層中亟待拯救。

source: A Fleeting Night's Dream
A Fluffy Prescription

source:
A Jinzhou, vous rencontrez Encore en vacances. Elle vous fait une invitation spéciale -
L'aventure est sur le point de commencer ! Embarquons pour un voyage passionnant avec votre meilleure amie, la Bêê aventurière !
target: 你在今州城內遇到了正在度假的安可，她向你發出邀請——故事就要開始啦，作為安可的好朋友，要和羊咩勇士一起到故事裏去冒險嗎？

source: A Linha Entre a Vida e a Morte
A Logística Lollo fez uma parceria com a Associação dos Pioneiros para lançar um novo evento com recompensas generosas. Vá até o caminhão de entregas para saber mais.
target: 先行公約與嗚嗚物流似乎聯合推出了獎勵豐厚的新活動，去物流車那裡看看吧。

source: A Noite Estrelada
A Nova Celebração Solar começou, e todo o campus está em festa. Dirija-se ao local e junte-se às festividades!
target: 換日慶典開啟後，學院洋溢著輕鬆的氣息。前往慶典會場附近，享受節日的氣氛吧。

target: 拉古那城中，一位音樂家正對著自己的聲骸伙伴「麥樂帝」愁眉不展……

source: A Resposta Está onde Cai um Rio de Estrelas
A Reverberação na loja de Lyu Yi parece estar conectada àquela que escapou do Domínio Xuanyuan... Informe a Ruoyun sobre a situação.
target: 呂一所見那個殘響似乎就是玄元境中逃逸的殘響，和若雲說明一下情況吧。

source: A Roya student seems to be having a hard time transporting her research equipment...
target: 羅伊族學生在運輸研究設備時似乎遇到了困難……

source: A Secret
A Snowbound Order from Cobalt Blue
A Soliskin and Its Mysterious Friend
A Sombra do Passado
A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.
target: 你受到莫寧委託，前往調查突然出現的心之集域。

source: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.
target: 你收到莫寧委託，前往調查突然出現的心之集域。

source: A Sra. Jué está preocupada com Guhong, que visita regularmente os idosos, mas não apareceu nos últimos dias. Ajude-a a encontrá-lo.
target: 每天拜訪老人們的孤鴻已經有好幾天沒出現了，玨婆婆很擔心，幫幫她吧。

source: A Stranger in a Strange Land
A Street Lighter's Night Walk
A Taste of Everything
A Tempestade Está Por Vir

A WavesLine message arrives from a strange account named "Lightborne Horizons." With almost contagious enthusiasm, the sender invites you to join a photography event called "Light Chaser Collection"…
target: 你收到了來自陌生帳號「光年視界」傳來的飛訊，對方似乎正熱情滿滿地邀請你參加名為「尋光集」的攝影同好活動……

source: A WavesLine message from an anonymous sender draws you into a world of urban legends, unknowns, and anomalies. Investigate, record them, or verify, debunk them... Present evidence strong enough to speak for itself.
target: 一條來自匿名對象的飛訊，將你拉入怪談、未知和異常的世界，調查、記錄它們，還是驗證、拆穿它們……用足以證明的證據，給出回應吧。

source: A WavesLine message has come in from Jingran. Go with him and get to the bottom of this old Nethermancer story.
target: 收到了景燃的飛訊，和他一探尋幽客舊事相關的究竟吧。

source: A Wolf's Companion
A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You
A batalha pela cidade teve uma pausa. Como estão os Guardas de Xuanfang agora?
target: 守城戰已告一段落，目前，定玄衛們的情況又是如何呢？

source: A batalha pela cidade teve uma pausa. Como estão os Guardiões Xuanfang agora?
target: 守城戰已告一段落，目前，定玄衛們的情況又是如何呢？

source: A bondade outrora plantada agora dá frutos.
target: 曾經釋放的善意，如今開花結果。

source: A busca contra a malevolência
A busca por objetos à deriva está chegando ao fim. Como de costume, você se dirige ao Café Shashou…
target: 不知不覺間，這趟漂流物搜尋之旅已經接近尾聲。如往常一樣，你再次來到了列車長咖啡廳……

source:
A challenge called "Moon Shooter" is known at the Moonlit Fair. Interesting challenges like this are meant for Chixia... and you!

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.
target:
宵月會上有一個名為「射月壺」的挑戰，這麼有趣的挑戰，怎麼能少了你和熾霞呢？

完成此任務後解鎖新的經營夥伴。

source: A convite de Lumi, você chega a uma festa sem fim...
target: 應燈燈邀請，你來到一個無盡的宴會……

source: A cortina caiu sobre as grandes competições. Coloque sua medalha e siga para o Vale da Glória, onde tomará uma decisão que poderá mudar o rumo da história.
target: 大賽已然落幕，佩戴勛章，走向榮耀之間，做出那個能夠改變故事走向的抉擇吧。

source: A crise acabou, mas Rinascita ainda tem um longo caminho pela frente…
target: 危機結束了，但黎那汐塔要走的路還有很長很長……

source: A crying girl
A cryptic message reveals the Séance Society's involvement in Jinzhou's disappearances. Is this the key to unlocking the truth?
target: 從一封神秘的來信之中得知了名為「歸魂互助會」的組織存在，可能與今州城內的失踪案件有關。

source: A divindade hibernante aguarda silenciosamente a chegada dos peregrinos. Para distinguir a verdade das mentiras, busque respostas deste ser divino.
target: 沉眠的神祇靜默地等候著謁見者的到來。 真與假、虛與實，請至神明面前一一求證。

source: A equipe de pesquisa da Floresta Obscura enviou um sinal de socorro urgente, solicitando sua assistência com um problema preocupante.
target: 無光之森的勘察小隊發來緊急求救信號，希望你能幫忙解決他們遇到的問題。

source: A esperança não se encontra na primavera, mas no inverno profundo, quando a vida começa a brotar pela primeira vez.
target: 希望不在春天，而在第一次抽芽的深冬。

source: A estranha e sinistra história da “Caminhada Noturna do Acendedor de Rua” acaba por ser um conto de um dos livros de Zhuangyu.
target: 那詭秘離奇的「霧燈夜行」之事，原來是莊虞的話本故事。

source: A familiar figure appears on the balcony. Go talk to her and catch up.
target: 一個熟悉的身影出現在了露台上，去和她敘敘舊吧。

source: A familiar voice echoes through the dreamscape's frequencies, introducing himself as "Ebony Gatekeeper." You decide to seek him out and uncover what he's up to.
target: 夢境的頻率裡傳來了似曾相識的聲音，對面自稱「黑色守門人」……總之，先去看看這傢伙想做什麼吧。

source: A film crew from the Pioneer Association is shooting documentary footage and they need your help.
target: 來自先行公約的劇組正在拍攝紀錄片素材，他們需要你的幫助。

source: A film crew from the Pioneer Association is shooting footage for a documentary, and they might just need your help.
target: 來自先行公約的劇組正在拍攝紀錄片素材，也許他們需要你的幫助。

source: A girl called Dorothy appears next to a mysterious gate. She claims a sudden crisis is taking place inside.
target: 名為多蘿西的女孩出現在了神秘門扉旁。據她所言，門扉的另一側出現了突如其來的危機。

source: A girl named Anita invites you into the Peaks of Prestige fan club. From her, you learn that the club is hanging by a thread...
target: 一位名叫安妮塔的女生邀你加入了《榮耀之丘》同好會，你從她那裡得知，同好會目前正面臨解散的危機……

source: A group of Exiles was suddenly found. Go and defeat them.
target: 一群流放者突然出現，前往並擊退他們。

source: A group of Tacet Discords are contaminating the water source leading to the waterfall. Defeat them before they can cause irreparable damage.
target: 一群殘象污染了瀑布上游的水源，在它們造成不可挽回的損失前擊敗它們。

source: A group of Tacet Discords are gathering on the outskirts of Hongzhen. Defeat them before they become a threat to the town.
target: 一群殘象在虹鎮郊外集結。 在它們入侵城鎮前擊敗它們。

source: A group of Tacet Discords has appeared near the hot spring, posing a threat to the safety of the residents of Hongzhen. Defeat them before they can form into a greater number.
target: 一群殘象出沒在溫泉附近，對虹鎮的居民的安全造成了威脅。 在它們聚集之前擊敗它們。

source: A guardiã da costa pode ter algumas pistas sobre as frequências enfraquecidas de Abby. Volte para a Costa Negra para descobrir.
target: 有關阿布的頻率衰減問題，或許守岸人那邊已經有了些許線索，先回黑海岸看看吧。

source: A handful of Exiles are roaming around the wild. Go and defeat them.
target: 一小撮流放者正於野外流竄，前往並打倒他們。

source: A hora que você combinou com Zhenliu chegou. Vá para o Ministério da Guerra e pergunte a ela que ajuda é necessária hoje.
target: 和枕流約好的時間到了，去軍策府找她問問今天要幫什麼忙吧。

source:
A investigação da pintura mórfica misteriosa conclui-se sem problemas — parece que Claudia deseja te agradecer pessoalmente.
Talvez seja hora de falar com ela de novo.
target:
神秘聲骸畫的調查告一段落了，克勞迪亞似乎想要對你表達感謝。
和克勞迪亞談談吧。

source: A invitación de Lumi, llegas a un festival sin fin...
target: 應燈燈邀請，你來到一個無盡的宴會……

source: A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...
target: 一位早已死去的船長，一艘無法啟航的船。而現在，那位船長已經走上必然之路，這艘船，也該再次啟航……

source: A lua será minha convidada
A man named Ham has invited you to participate in the Spacetrek Incubation Program...
target: 一個名叫厄姆的男人邀請你參與「深空孵化計劃」……

source: A medida que avanza la Iniciativa Lumen, los árboles ancestrales contaminados han vuelto a la normalidad, y los Solistirpes parecen interesados en ellos...
target: 隨著「拓光計劃」的推進，虛蝕古代喬木得以恢復正常，而日靈們似乎也對這些樹很感興趣……

source: A medida que el proyecto se acerca a su fecha límite, Alannah propone un plan final...
target: 專案期限將至，阿蘭娜提出了最後一個方案……

source: A medida que el tiempo vuelve al orden, la nieve se despeja. El Monte Firmamento está aquí para celebrar su renacimiento tras eras de reclusión.
target: 時流回正、風雪已消，在漫長的歲月後，乘霄山重見於世，迎來煥然新生。

source: A medida que la Campaña se acerca a su conclusión, surge una urgencia. Se necesita tu ayuda inmediata para solucionar la situación…
target: 企劃迎來了尾聲，在最後一天，嗚嗚導航的神秘功能竟被加急使用……

source: A medida que las mareas de peligro retroceden, Jinzhou parece tranquilo y vibrante. Pero más allá de sus fronteras yace un campo de batalla feroz y desesperado.
target: 流生百態，伏波砥行。安寧昌盛的今州城外，是危機四伏的殘酷戰場。

source: A medida que se acerca el Festival de la Caza de la Luna, regresas a Jinzhou y escuchas los cuentos del "Cobijo del Árbol" bajo el Árbol de deseos. Un encuentro con un extraño robot te vincula al Benefactor anónimo del Cobijo...
target: 追月節將近，回到今州的你聽聞了祈願樹下的「月樹屋」傳說，與神秘機器人的相遇將你與月樹屋的幕後英雄，連繫在了一起……

source: A menina atrás do teatro parece ter dificuldade em procurar o presente que sua irmã deixou para ela. Vá e descubra a situação.
target: 劇院後的女孩正在尋找姐姐留給她的禮物，但尋寶過程中她似乎遇到了困難，去了解一下情況吧。

source: A minuit, vous avez tombé sur un incident criminelle et vous retrouvez un visage familier...
target: 你在深夜目擊了一起犯罪事件。令你意外的是，你在犯罪現場遇到了某位熟人……

source: A musician in Ragunna City seems troubled by his Echo companion Melody...
target: 拉古那城中，一位音樂家正對著自己的聲骸伙伴「麥樂帝」愁眉不展……

source: A mysterious Tacet Discord has appeared. Forces are needed at Port City of Guixu to defeat it.
target: 神秘的強大殘象出現，亟需人手前往歸墟港市將其討伐。

source: A mysterious combat simulation program has gone viral on the Academy's Huaxu Hive. Researcher Lizhu, an active user, seems to have insights on this intriguing program...
target: 近期，華胥研究院內部的今涯論壇上流行著一個來路不明的模擬戰鬥程式。研究員驪珠作為資深論壇人士，似乎對此有話要說……

source:
A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by.
A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.
target:
一封神秘郵件，輕輕挑起籠罩著過往的夜紗一角——
那沉溺於深淵之底的低聲呼喚，等待著你的回答。

source: A neglected street painter is seeking help. Go and see for yourself.
target: 無人問津的街頭畫家正在尋求幫助，去看看是什麼情況吧。

source: A noite estrelada
A nova temporada da Corrida Tochestrela está prestes a começar! Confiante em suas habilidades de pilotagem, você não vê a hora de participar.
target: 新一屆星炬競速賽即將開跑！對摩托駕駛充滿信心的你已經躍躍欲試。

source: A orientação da Associação dos Pioneiros leva você a um lugar intrigante conhecido como a Aldeia Pelúcia.
target: 在先行公約的指引下，你來到了一個名叫布偶村的奇妙場所……

source: A pair of cautious eyes from the corner of Margherita's restaurant seem to call for your attention. Drop by and take a look when you have the chance.
target: 從「瑪格烈特」的角落傳來了一道猶豫的視線……有空的話去看看怎麼回事吧。

source: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.
target: 一組不斷游移的神秘空間坐標意外進入了你們的視野。循著它的指向，你觸碰到了一座早已覆滅的……都市。

source: A persistência compensa a mediocridade

A pesar de arruinar los malvados planes de los Fractsidus en el Monte Firmamento, sus remanentes siguen activos cerca de las ruinas de la Espina del Dragón. Derrótalos antes de que causen más problemas.
target: 殘星會建立了先鋒營地，以作為再次入侵乘霄山的跳板。不要給他們任何可乘之機。

source: A pesar de sus muchos fracasos, has decidido darle a Lelia una oportunidad más. ¿Tendrá éxito esta vez?
target: 雖然萊麗婭已經失敗了很多次，但你還是決定再給少女一次機會。這一次，她會成功嗎？

source: A pesquisadora da Costa Negra está te esperando para testar suas novas ideias.
target: 黑海岸研究員在等待著和你一起驗證她的最新構想。

source: A poeira do incidente dos Nós da Paisagem Onírica assentou por agora. Vá falar com o gato branco na cidade de Ragunna.
target: 拉古那地區夢境節點的事暫時告一段落了，去拉古那城找白貓聊聊吧。

source: A por los pescados
A priceless package has been shipped across the ocean to Ragunna. It is said that its freight insurance premium alone costs millions of credits!
target: 有個昂貴的包裹遠渡重洋被送來拉古那，聽說光是運費險就高達十位數！

source: A primeira tentativa de Yongxin terminou tragicamente. Será que um milagre surgirá na segunda tentativa?
target: 永新的第一單生意以絕對的慘敗告終，第二單會創造奇跡嗎？

source: A próxima edição do diário está em andamento. Vá e confira o conteúdo em destaque.
target: 新一期的刊物即將定稿，去了解一下這次會有些什麼內容吧。

source: A reitora Lucilla apresenta você a um estudante chamado Grahame. Ela o encarrega de se juntar a ele em uma "viagem de formatura" às Planícies de Dimmr...
target: 洛瑟菈校長將你介紹給一位名叫格雷厄姆的同學。她委託你同這位同學一起於黯原來一場「畢業旅行」……

source: A researcher in charge of supplies is in trouble and needs help.
target: 一位在收集物資的研究員遇到了困難，似乎需要些許幫助。

source: A resident named Jianji is gathering funds in the city under a foundation's name, promising investors a remarkably handsome return. It sounds like a fine chance to get rich...
target: 一個名叫簡集的居民在城中以基金會的名義吸納資金，並承諾會付給投資人相當可觀的分潤。這聽起來是個發財的好機會……

source: A robot active on the suspension platform is emitting strange sounds…
target: 在懸台上活動的機器人發出了詭異的聲音……

source: A sabedoria antiga diz que tudo neste mundo é útil à sua maneira. No entanto, como alguém poderia distinguir o útil do inútil? Talvez, este jovem chamado Shinong saiba como...
target: 老話說：天生萬物，必有其用。 但如何從其中分辨可用之物呢？ 也許這個名為什濃的年輕人能給出一個答案……

source: A sailor named Starbuck has fallen into mental turmoil—rumor has it, a fish drove him to this state...
target: 那位叫做斯塔巴克斯的水手陷入了精神錯亂之中，據說，是因為一條魚他才變成了現在這副模樣……

source: A sempre calma Roccia entra em contato com você com um pedido urgente. Vá para a Praia e verifique os “peregrinos” banidos.
target:
一向穩重的洛可可在通訊中向你發出緊急求助——
去船葬灘看看，被放逐的人們，需要些什麼吧。

source: A sessão de treinamento de Faro está marcada, mas as DTs próximas parecem estar atacando transeuntes — é melhor verificar isso primeiro.
target: 指導法羅訓練的時間到了。附近似乎有殘象正在襲擊過路的人，先去看看情況。

source: A shroud of mist and gloom envelops the mire, concealing the untold tales of the past. A mournful melody lingers in the air, offering condolences to lives that have long journeyed to the next world.
target: 迷霧與陰霾籠罩了沼澤的深處，塵封著不為人知的往事。哀歌兀自響起，獻給早已行至彼岸的生命。

source: A small Septimontian hands Mya a bouquet of Bloodleaf Viburnum.
target: 七丘的孩子贈給了蜜芽一束血葉莢蒾。

source: A small game cartridge could be a vessel of a captivating world of sounds, landscapes, lores, and inspirations... KU-Cass needs your assistance to recover the old game cartridges to listen again to the sounds of a lost past.
target: 小小的遊戲卡帶裡濃縮著大量的聲音、風景，還有故事和寄託的期待……庫卡斯希望你能幫它找回遺失的卡帶，再次聆聽過去文明的聲音。

source: A squad in the Land of Xuanfang has repeatedly failed its combat qualification, and the Autopuppet leading it wants your guidance.
target: 玄方地界有一支在實戰考核中屢次受挫的小隊，身為隊長的機傀想要尋求你的指導。

source: A strange Royan merchant arrives near the Relay Station, unusually warm and eager to involve you in an odd transaction…
target: 整流車站附近來了一位陌生的羅伊商人。他待你格外熱絡，似乎想要邀請你參加一場古怪的交易……

source: A strange researcher is trying to talk to cats through a special function of her Terminal...
target: 奇怪的研究員正試圖與小貓對話，她的終端似乎有什麼特殊功能……

source: A strange school of pufferfish has suddenly appeared by the river. The researcher nearby might know what's going on...
target: 一群奇怪的河豚突然出現在河邊，也許旁邊的研究員知道這是怎麼回事……

source: A student from the Department of Voidmatters appears to have made a new discovery...
target: 虛質科學部的學生似乎在研究中有了意外發現……

source: A vida é cheia de surpresas e... acidentes. Claro, não há exceção para Shinong.
target: 人生總是充滿了驚喜與意外，對於什濃來說，當然也是如此。

target: 黎喬利島上出現一位神秘的面具人，衣著體面，卻有著不同於儀表的瘋癲……

source: The displaced long to rebuild the Old District into their new home, but evil clings like a shadow.
target: 流離失所的人們希望重建舊街獲得新家園，但惡意卻如影隨形。

source: The dust of Ragunna's Dreamscape Nodes incident has settled for now. Go talk to the white cat in Ragunna City.
target: 拉古那地區夢境節點的事暫時告一段落了，去拉古那城找白貓聊聊吧。

source: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!
target: 前往拉海洛的隧道已然開啟，那片在冰原之下的地底點亮的炬火，正在等待著你的「歸來」。

source: The girl behind the theater seems to have trouble looking for the gift her sister left her. Go and learn about the situation.
target: 劇院後的女孩正在尋找姐姐留給她的禮物，但尋寶過程中她似乎遇到了困難，去了解一下情況吧。

source: The hibernating deity silently awaits the pilgrims' arrival. To distinguish truth from lies, seek answers from this divine being.
target: 沉眠的神祇靜默地等候著謁見者的到來。 真與假、虛與實，請至神明面前一一求證。

source: The incident has been resolved. Accept Lynae's invitation and meet her at the square fountain.
target: 事件已然落幕。接受琳奈的邀請，前往廣場的水池邊與她見面吧。

source: The injured in Xuanfang Hold entrusted Jin to pass along a gift to you, and also prepared a token of gratitude for Baizhi. But Baizhi, occupied with research, has already returned to Jinzhou ahead of time...
target: 玄方城的傷患們托矜轉交給你一份禮物，也特意為白芷備下了謝禮。只是白芷因研究事務，已經先一步返回今州……

source:
The investigation of the mysterious morph painting concludes smoothly, and it seems Claudia wishes to thank you in person.
Perhaps it's time to pay her a visit.
target:
神秘聲骸畫的調查告一段落了，克勞迪亞似乎想要對你表達感謝。
和克勞迪亞談談吧。

source: The kindness once sown now bears fruit.
target: 曾經釋放的善意，如今開花結果。

source: The lighthouse at the Wuming Bay has lost power. Try to restore its power!
target: 位於無明灣的燈塔失去了供電，嘗試使燈塔恢復運轉吧！

source: The long-awaited Carnevale is finally set to begin. Together with your friends, you are ready to thwart the Fractsidus' schemes during the celebration...
target: 時隔已久的狂歡節終於即將開幕，你與伙伴們已經做好準備，要在狂歡節上阻止殘星會的行動……

source: The matter of Muyu has come to a temporary close, but the crisis of the rogue Autopuppets is far from over...
target: 木禺之事暫告一段落，但機傀失控的危機尚未解除……

source: The mysterious contact, the Outcast ambushes, the driver you keep running into… everything is finally coming together.
target: 神秘的聯絡人、流民的襲擊、偶遇多次的司機，這一切即將真相大白……

source: The nagging engineer Mizhi always mentions hearing a mysterious sound calling him...
target: 神神叨叨的工程師覓知總說有什麼聲音在召喚他……

source: The new lesson site is in the Western Fang Peaks. When the appointed time comes, go meet Qingxiao there.
target: 新的教學地點在方擎西峰。到了約定的時間，就去那裡和清宵見面吧。

source: The new season of the Startorch Race is about to begin! Confident in your vehicle-handling skills, you are more than ready to jump in.
target: 新一屆星炬競速賽即將開跑！對摩托駕駛充滿信心的你已經躍躍欲試。

source: The newly planted flowers in the Greenhouse have bloomed. Go take a look.
target: 黑海岸花房的新品花種開放了，去看看吧

source: The old man looking at the cemetery from a distance hopes to pay tribute with the flowers he holds to his past comrades. Please help him fulfill his wishes.
target: 遙望公墓的老人希望將自己手中的鮮花獻給過去的戰友，請幫忙完成他的心願吧。

source: The ominous sound drifting from the fog lures the lost seafarers, drawing them into the land of death where Tacet Discords run wild.
target: 霧中傳來的聲音吸引著迷途的航者，卻也將其引向覆滿殘象的死亡之國。

source: The painter begs that you help him solicit customers. Work together to push forward the plan.
target: 畫家再次懇求你幫他招攬生意，請配合他完成計畫吧。

source: The road trip movie is nearing its end, and your journey together has truly made her happy and content.
target: 公路片已經放映到了尾聲，與你一同的這趟旅途，的確讓她感到完滿和快樂。

source: The schemes of the Fractsidus are starting to unravel. Determined to seek the truth, you set forth to Averardo Vault...
target: 殘星會的陰謀已然揭開一角。你決定前往埃弗拉德金庫，探尋仍舊隱藏在帷幕之下的謎團……

source: The sea has calmed, but Captain Ahab and his crew are gone. Ishmael, who first brought you to the Riccioli Islands, seems to be studying the relics left behind by the legendary captain…
target: 大海重歸平靜，亞哈船長一行人卻消失不見。介紹你來到黎喬利群島的伊什麥爾，似乎正研究著亞哈船長留下來的遺物……

source: The search for castaway objects is coming to an end. As usual, you head to Shashou Cafe…
target: 不知不覺間，這趟漂流物搜尋之旅已經接近尾聲。如往常一樣，你再次來到了列車長咖啡廳……

source: The supply-starved camp is in desperate need of medical supplies…
target: 物資匱乏的營地裡，急需藥品援助……

source: The surveying of the Dimmr Deep is at a critical juncture. Help the researchers recover their Geospider S4, which Soliskin Banana has taken for a joyride.
target: 恆黯之原勘探任務已到關鍵階段，幫助科考小隊尋回被日靈芭娜娜騎走的岩蛛S4。

source: The tasks is complete. Wicktorio wants to discuss your... fees.
target: 委託結束後，維托里奧似乎想要和你談談……該結算一下委託費了。

source: The test concluded successfully. It's time to report back to Kinova.
target: 測試圓滿結束，是時候去找基諾烏了。

source: The time has come to unravel the secrets of the Forbidden Archive...
target: 是時候解開禁書院的秘密了.....

source: The time you arranged with Zhenliu has come. Head to the Ministry of War and ask her what help is needed today.
target: 和枕流約好的時間到了，去軍策府找她問問今天要幫什麼忙吧。

source: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. Enjoy the beautiful sunset with your companion.
target: 七丘的風波告一段落，和你一路同行的她共賞這美麗黃昏吧。

source: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. Enjoy the moment of peaceful respite with your fellow traveler.
target: 七丘的風波告一段落，和你一路尋找的她享受這片刻寧靜吧。

source: The turmoil in Septimont has been resolved. The young lady who offered you help is now on vacation.
target: 七丘的風波告一段落，曾為你送上助益的她正在享受美好假日。

source: The upcoming issue of the journal is in progress. Go and check out the featured content.
target: 新一期的刊物即將定稿，去了解一下這次會有些什麼內容吧。

source: The worried painter has lost his former vigor. Ask him why and offer your help.
target: 愁眉苦臉的畫家失去了往日的活力，前去詢問原因並提供幫助吧。

source: There is a perfect bird-watching spot in the Academy only Sigrika knows...
target: 學院裡有一處觀鳥的聖地，只有西格莉卡知道……

source: There seems to be a commotion going on in the Old District, with a noblewoman surrounded by a crowd. She looks all too familiar…
target: 舊街突然傳來喧嚷，人們將一位貴婦圍堵起來，這人你並不陌生……

source: There's no telling whether Jingran is doing any better. Go pay him a visit.
target: 不知道景燃現在的狀態有沒有好轉，去探望一下他吧。

source:
These recordings from the past chronicle the days when the Autopuppets were trapped in their mission.
The mission is over now, and they wish never to wake again.
target:
這些來自過去的錄音記錄著機兵過去被困在任務中的時光。
如今任務已經結束，它們希望自己以後不再醒來。

source: Thespian's Coronation
They say Qiuhong in Xuanfang Hold has been gathering Rafter Kites. Might be worth swinging by to find out more.
target: 聽說秋鴻正在玄方城裡收集梁鳶……有空時去玄方城裡問問看吧。

source: Things have settled for the moment. It's time to visit Ero...
target: 事情暫時告一段落，是時候去拜訪埃羅了……

source: Third Stage
Third-rate Painter
This time the lesson has been moved to Boughrest Ridge. Head over and see what's in store.
target: 這一次，教學的地點改為了倚枝嶺。去那裡看看情況吧。

source: Though buried deep beneath the snow, the rusted iron bird still longs to sing.
target: 冰雪深埋之處，鏽蝕的鐵鳥卻欲高歌。

source: Though the promise of sharing a meal has yet to be fulfilled, now could be an opportune moment to catch up with her. If you have no other pressing matters, why not arrange a meeting in Jinzhou?
target: 和夥伴的一飯之約還沒兌現，似乎是時候和她好好見上一面了……沒有其他事的話，就回城裡看看吧？

Tidal Defense Simulator
Tief unter der Höhle, verdorben von der Dunklen Flut, wartet ein alter Gladiator schweigend auf sein Schicksal. Er ist ein verrostetes Schwert und träumt von den Tagen der Vergangenheit.
target: 黑潮侵蝕的谷底，年老的角鬥士靜靜等待著宿命到來。他是業已腐朽的劍，做著有關過去的夢。

target: 時流回正、風雪已消，在漫長的歲月後，乘霄山重見於世，迎來煥然新生。

source: Time to Study
To Mt. Firmament
To apply for funding, Ronan and his colleagues have each submitted a research proposal. Can you guess which one ends up getting approved?
target: 羅南等人為申請研究經費，各自提出了一個研究方案。不知道你能不能猜得到，最終被選中的是哪個方案？

source: To complete a special school project, Zenus entered the Dimmr Plains alone...
target: 為了完成一個特殊的課題，澤納斯獨自進入了黯原……

source: To find the Exostrider and uncover the truth behind your frequency loss, you step into the falling snow and venture toward the silent, pale expanse of the frostlands.
target: 為了探尋隧者與頻率流失的真相，你將步入落雪，前往那寂靜蒼白的冰原。

source: To help Mornye reach her research goals, you've prepared a special schedule for her. Go meet her.
target: 為了幫莫寧達成她的實驗目標，你為她準備了特別的日程。現在去和她會合吧。

source: To keep Abbowser from causing more trouble, you have to keep advancing in the Abbowser Castle.
target: 為了避免布大王再有空搗蛋，需要繼續攻掠魔王城。

source: To learn more about Lahai-Roi, you begin searching for castaway objects throughout Honami City. Time to visit Shashou Cafe. What object will you find this time?
target: 為了更多地了解拉海洛地區，你開始尋找散落在穗波市各處的漂流物。前往列車長咖啡廳吧，不知道這次會找到什麼樣的漂流物。

source: To live up to everyone's expectations, Sigrika has been training hard at the training grounds. Go meet her.
target: 為了回應大家的期望，西格莉卡正在訓練場努力訓練。去見見她吧。

source: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...
target: 為了開啟歲主遺留的舊物，你再一次回到了拉古那……

source: To reach your goal, you delve deeper into the Exostrider plan, all the while, anomalies hidden in the frostlands reveal themselves.
target: 為了你的目標，你決定繼續深入隧者計劃。而隱藏在冰原之旅的異樣之處，也將展露於你眼前。

source: To revive the Auto Empire, King Auto has a favor to ask of you.
target: 為了復興機甲帝國，甲大王有事拜託你。

source: To the Place of the Quill
To the Shore's End
To the Stars Yet to Shine
To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deeper you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...
target: 為了弄清楚吉爾貝究竟在聲骸失控事件中扮演了什麼角色，你跟隨他留下的蹤跡來到了城外，但事件的真相似乎越來越撲朔迷離……

target: 你與累陶一起修好了故障的取偶匣，並了解了取偶匣出現故障的原因。

Tomorrow Is As Far As the Shimmer

Ton vieux pote Maji est revenu en disant qu'il a une « nouvelle idée géniale » pour son projet, allons voir si on peut l'aider !
target: 你的老朋友馬計三度出山，聲稱帶來了「全新打法」，是的，正如你所想，你的老朋友永遠需要你的幫助。

target: 完成飛簷同好會設置的所有賽道，阿水看上去非常興奮。下一次，還有機會挑戰新場地嗎？

target: 不是所有在大海上留下寶藏的都是海盜，也有可能只是一位普通的水手……或者船長。

source: Tras comenzar la celebración, Lynae te envía otro mensaje en WavesLine. Acepta su invitación y acompáñala a almorzar.

source: Tras finalizar la Celebración del Nuevo Sol, te enteras por el mensaje que Lucilla envió de que las anomalías procedentes del Lado Oscuro todavía no cesan. Te pude que la ayudes a sacar la verdad a la luz...
target: 換日慶典結束後，洛瑟菈傳來飛訊告訴你暗面異變的問題還未完全解決，希望你能協助她調查出真相……

source: Tras la batalla de Baldíos de Norfall, todo llegó a su fin. Tus amigos te están llamando para una quedada con aperitivos en el Restaurante de Panhua. Parece que les gustaría saber más sobre esa "pequeñaja" que viene de dentro de tu cuerpo...
target: 北落野一役後，一切告一段落。 暫別的夥伴準備了吃食，約你在攀花飯館重聚，關於那個從你身體裡鑽出來的「小傢伙」，她們似乎也有許多想要了解……

source: Tras la crisis de los Títeres, parece que la tierra de Xuanfang vuelve a la normalidad...
target: 機傀危機過後，玄方地界的形勢暫時平穩了下來……

source: Tras tu inesperado encuentro con Lynae, te matriculas bajo su guía. La Academia Fuegostelar, la Unión Intergaláctica y la Ceremonia del Nuevo Sol… poco a poco, esta «Capital Académica» comienza a revelarse ante ti.

target: 由於長途跋涉，布偶小隊的成員們都變得髒兮兮的……快想辦法幫助大家重新變得乾淨吧。

source: Você ajudou Fratellone a resolver todos os problemas e ele quer agradecer você pessoalmente.

source: Você ajudou os três irmãos com seus respectivos problemas e eles querem agradecer pessoalmente.
target: 你分別幫助三兄弟完成了各自的難題，現在他們想親自向你道謝……

source: Você ajudou uma estudante chamada Ang a recuperar seu guia de observação estelar. Para ela, é mais que apenas um livreto; ele carrega o peso de uma promessa que ela compartilhou com suas amigas...
target: 你幫助一位名叫安格的學生找到了她需要的觀星指南，這本指南對她來說有著特殊的意義，似乎是關於她和她朋友間的一個約定。

source: Você aprendeu com Lingyang sobre a história de uma Fera-tinidora. Dizem que elas viviam nas proximidades da Figueira Violeta na Floresta Obscura. Por que não ir dar uma olhada?
target: 從凌陽口中得知了關於「丁零噹啷獸」的故事，據說它們曾在無光之森的紫月榕一帶棲息過，不如去紫月榕附近看看吧？

source: Você chamou a atenção de um assistente esperto do Terminal. Ele afirma que existe uma pista de corrida onde ninguém jamais cruzou a linha de chegada...
target: 你被一個終端的智慧助理吸引了注意力，他提到了一條無人能抵達終點的賽道……

source: Você coletou algumas “caixas de sonância”. Parece interessar ao Chenpi, o comerciante local de relíquias.
target: 在今州城外意外撿到了名為「聲匣」的古物，聽說今州的尋遺商人陳皮對聲匣頗為了解，不如找他問問情况。

source: Você concordou com Zhuo Shanyue em ajudar a recuperar os Maquinetes. Se encontrar um Maquinete rebelde, você pode intervir para recuperá-lo primeiro e depois informar Zhuo Shanyue sobre o local...
target: 你與琢山月約定協助回收機傀。若遇到異常機傀，可以先行出手回收，並將發現地點告知琢山月……

source: Você concordou em ajudar Zhenliu e pegou o pacote pequeno, mas pesado. Vá encontrar a pessoa a quem ele se destina.
target: 你答應幫助枕流，接下了這小而沉重的包裹，去尋找它應被交付的人吧。

source: Você concordou em aprender guqin com Qingxiao. Vá até o salão de treinamento dela para começar a próxima fase das suas lições.
target: 你已答應了跟清宵學琴，去她的道館開始下一步的學習吧。

source: Você conhece um estudante animado chamado Bjarki. Graças às recomendações dele, você quer saber mais sobre os diferentes "fã-clubes" da Academia...
target: 你遇到了一個名叫比亞爾基的熱心同學，在他的推薦下，你對學院中的各個「同好會」產生了強烈的興趣……

source: Você cruza caminhos com a gladiadora Lupa em Septimont.
target: 你與角鬥士少女露帕在七丘相遇。

source: Você descobriu o propósito e as direções das três fichas, mas as respostas para seus enigmas estão escondidas atrás de uma entrada misteriosa, que você encontrou com a ajuda das dicas do Relógio de Sol.
target: 三件信物的意圖與指向均顯，所有謎題的答案，似乎都隱藏在日晷所指向的那扇神秘大門之後。

source: Você descobriu uma moto de expedição no desfiladeiro gelado... Encontre uma maneira de trazê-la de volta para a Ascensão Estelar.

source: Você e Cartethyia lutam lado a lado em uma batalha que ninguém vê.
target: 你似乎與卡提希婭並肩進行了一場無人可見的戰鬥。

source: Você e as pelúcias viajam acima das nuvens, onde um mundo de maravilhas os espera.

source: Você encontra Jingran novamente por acaso, e ele parece ter esbarrado em um antigo caso envolvendo os Inframantes.

source: Você encontra Jingran novamente por acaso, e ele parece ter esbarrado em um antigo caso envolvendo os Inframantes.
target: 收到了景燃的飛訊，和他一探尋幽客舊事相關的究竟吧。

source: Você encontra Lenore, uma acólita da Ordem, ao lado de um Maschera d’Aria. Ela parece estar em apuros…
target: 伊諾爾似乎正對著留聲奏者一籌莫展……

source: Você encontra Lynae na Sala de Exibição. Será que ela... matou aula de novo? Talvez você devesse perguntar para ela.

source: Você encontra Maji mais uma vez. Recém-chegado da sede da Logística Lollo, ele parece determinado a relançar a Campanha Lollo.

source: Você encontra Maji, da Logística Lollo, em Ragunna. Que nova campanha ele está planejando?

source: Você encontra Xiangli Yao novamente sob a Árvore dos Desejos. No entanto, desta vez vocês compartilham uma caminhada não pelos desejos dos outros, mas pela glória da lua e pelas vidas agitadas das pessoas.
target: 祈願樹下，你又一次邂逅了相里要。你們再度同行，卻不為他人的願望，而是迎月色入懷，閑步在煙火人間。

target: 你又見到了懸音，她正在觀察屋簷上的鴿子們……

target: 你又見到了懸音，她在嘗試和灰冠鷗對話……

source: Você encontra crianças brincando de esconde-esconde. Elas prometem seu "tesouro" se você conseguir encontrar todas elas no tempo estipulado...
target: 你遇見了正在玩捉迷藏的孩子們，他們告訴你，如果在限定時間內能抓到所有人，他們就有份「寶藏」送給你，你決定……

source: Você encontra um holograma deixado por um pesquisador. Parece que ele está convidando você para experimentar a "obra-prima" da qual tanto se orgulha.

target: 你遇到了一個焦慮的研究員，他似乎正在尋找一批在黯原失去聯絡的準時寶……

source: Você encontra um robô incomum que parece ter uma visão bastante única da verdade por trás deste mundo...
target: 你遇到了一個奇怪的機器人，它似乎對這個世界的真相有著相當獨特的見解……

source: Você encontra um velho contador de histórias enquanto vagueia pela Vila Arco-Íris. Enquanto ouve os contos de imortalidade sobre o Monte Firmamento, você percebe outro ouvinte interessado...

source: Você encontra uma dupla estranha na Floresta Obscura. Eles parecem ter perguntas peculiares para você. Responda corretamente às perguntas deles e você pode receber algumas recompensas.

source: Você encontrou algumas estátuas peculiares nas Planícies de Dimmr. Elas parecem estar guardando um segredo oculto...
target: 你在黯原之上找到了一些奇怪的雕像，它們背後似乎藏著什麼秘密。

source: Você encontrou outro gato de rua. Resgate-o e leve-o para Xiaoju.

source: Você encontrou um Exilado atacado por Dissonâncias Transgressoras. Após testemunhar suas capacidades, ele busca sua ajuda.
target: 路遇被殘象圍攻的流放者，在瞭解你的身手後似乎有事需要你幫忙。

source: Você encontrou um pesquisador ansioso, que solicita sua ajuda para afastar os Mico-Chefes.
target: 你遇到一個焦急的研究員，她想麻煩你幫忙驅逐搗蛋猿。

source: Você entrega o "tesouro" tomado das crianças para I.R.I.S. A análise do sistema revela que está conectado a um professor desaparecido. Você decide investigar mais a fundo.
target: 你把從孩子那裡拿到的「寶藏」交給了I.R.I.S.，透過系統分析，這份「寶藏」與一位失蹤的教授有關，你決定調查這件事情。

target: 從學院的聊天群中，你了解到了一則愛看電影的幽靈巫女怪談，你決定前往電影放映教室一探究竟。

source: Você frustrou os planos vis do Fractiverso no Monte Firmamento, mas suas forças remanescentes ainda estão ativas perto das ruínas da Serra do Dragão. Derrote-os antes que possam causar mais danos.

source: Você marcou de tocar um dueto com Qingxiao hoje. Vá até aquele pavilhão familiar perto do Ministério da Guerra. Ela está esperando por você.

source: Você obteve um objeto estranho de Chenpi, que insinuou ser uma chave para um segredo há muito esquecido.
target: 你從陳皮那裡得到了一把奇怪的鑰匙。這把鑰匙似乎能够打開一扇塵封已久的秘密之門。

source: Você obteve um veículo. Siga as instruções do WavesLine e vá ao Terminal de Treinamento para concluir o tutorial de pilotagem de veículos.
target: 你已經獲得了運具，根據飛訊的指引，去教學終端完成運具駕駛教學吧。

source: Você pode pescar mais do que apenas peixes quando estiver no mar...

source: Você recebe uma ligação de Fulmine, a quem algumas "pessoas" misteriosas pediram para te mandar um convite...

source: Você recebe uma mensagem de Encore, dizendo que obteve algo super incrível e divertido, e que está animada para compartilhar com você. O que poderia ser?
target: 你接到安可的通訊，她說有一個非常厲害非常好玩的東西想要和你分享，到底是什麼呢？

source: Você recebe uma mensagem de Lucilla solicitando sua presença no escritório da Secretaria Acadêmica para discutir os planos. No lugar da ocupada reitora, Hiyuki se encontrará com você.
target: 你接到洛瑟菈的聯絡，她希望你前往教務處商議後續事宜。緋雪會代替忙碌的校長與你見面。

source: Você recebe uma mensagem enviada por engano: Ronan afirma ter testemunhado a "evolução milagrosa de um Baiacrona" e animadamente convida você para ver...
target: 你收到了一條錯傳的訊息，傳訊人羅南自稱發現了「一隻冠頂鼴雀的進化奇跡」，熱情邀請你前往一同見證……

source: Você recebe uma mensagem no WavesLine pedindo ajuda. Verifique do que se trata.
target: 你收到了一條求助飛訊，去看看是誰需要幫助吧。

source: Você recebe uma mensagem urgente da Academia Huaxu para suporte de emergência. Dirija-se ao local designado para mais informações.
target: 收到了來自華胥研究所的緊急情况支援通訊，前往通訊中標注的地址查看情况。

source: Você recebeu um contato dos Guardiões de Marfim e Ébano. Algo deve ter acontecido com Sonúmia.
target: 你收到了黑色守門人和白色守門人的聯絡，似乎是心之集域中出現了一些新的情況。

source: Você recebeu um convite para uma festa de tiro peculiar, aparentemente relacionada ao robô danificado em Serra do Assentamento. Vá conferir.
target: 你收到了一個奇怪的射擊派對的邀請，這似乎和落定嶺上損壞的機器人有關，參加看看吧。

source: Você recebeu uma carta de convite de Wenshu. Ela menciona que os “Jogos Ribeirinhos de Jinzhou” serão realizados em breve. Vá para as coordenadas anexadas na carta e dê uma olhada.
target: 你收到了一封來自文叔的邀請函，信中提到「今州競渡會」舉辦在即，去信中附上的座標處看看吧？

source: Você recebeu uma mensagem do gato branco de Sonúmia. Vá falar com ele na Cidade de Ragunna.
target: 收到了來自心之集域的白貓的訊息，去拉古那城找它聊聊吧。

source: Você recebeu uma mensagem no WavesLine de um remetente desconhecido
target: 你收到一條未知聯絡人的飛訊

source: Você recebeu uma mensagem. Fale com Langsheng.
Você recebeu uma nova mensagem do Covil do Caçador: examine os rastros deixados pelas DTs e vá atrás deles.
target: 狩獵者營地傳來新的訊息：請你比對殘象留下的痕跡，找到獵物的去向。

source: Você recebeu uma tarefa de Jinzhou. O quê? Farinha em Ragunna custa apenas metade do preço de Jinzhou?!
target: 你收到了一份來自今州的代購委託單——拉古那的麵粉定價居然只有今州的一半？！

source: Você resgata Jianji e descobre que todo o caso foi obra de Exilados que se infiltraram em Xuanfang. Você recupera os fundos e, com a ajuda do Pavilhão da Passagem, devolve-os às vítimas.
target: 你救出了簡集，並發現這起事件是混入玄方城的流放者所為。你追回了資金，並在外事府的協助下將它們還給了受害者。

source: Você resgatou muitos gatos de rua. Vá ao Restaurante de Xiaoju para ver como eles estão.

source: Você resgatou um Maschera d’Aria ferido perto da Cidade de Septimont. Ele te confia quatro Caixas de Melodia, cada uma carregando uma peça musical. Que história elas poderão contar?

source: Você retorna a Ragunna para ver se as consequências do Fabricatório das Profundezas afetaram as pessoas de lá, mas inesperadamente encontra Zani na cidade. Já que está aqui, vale a pena conversar com ela para se atualizar sobre a situação.
target: 你回到拉古那，想看看隱海試驗場的動盪有沒有波及眾人，卻意外在城中見到了贊妮。既然如此，去與她談談吧。

source: Você se envolve no projeto de reconstrução do Observatório Sideral ajudando a reconstruir a rede de rotas de Lahai-Roi.
target: 你透過重建拉海洛路網的方式，正式開始協助深空測界台的重建工程……

source: Você se recusou a ajudar Zhenliu, mas ainda concordou em entregar o pacote e a lista ao seu destino. Vá encontrar o destinatário.

source:

source:
Vous apprenez la fête « Rêveries nocturnes » de la ville d'Egla et décidez de voir par vous-même le légendaire « Chevalier Fou ».

你在埃格拉小鎮聽聞了「幻想之夜」和「瘋癲騎士」的傳說,決定親眼去看看。

source: Vous avez accepté d'aider Zhenliu et avez pris le petit paquet important. Allez trouver la personne à qui il est destiné.
target: 你答應幫助枕流，接下了這小而沉重的包裹，去尋找它應被交付的人吧。

source: Vous avez accepté d'aider Zhuo Shanyue à récupérer les automates. Si vous rencontrez un automate rebelle, vous pouvez intervenir pour le récupérer d'abord, puis informer Zhuo Shanyue de l'emplacement...
target: 你與琢山月約定協助回收機傀。若遇到異常機傀，可以先行出手回收，並將發現地點告知琢山月……

source: Vous avez accepté d'apprendre le guqin auprès de Qingxiao. Rendez-vous à sa salle d'entraînement pour commencer la prochaine étape de vos leçons.
target: 你已答應了跟清宵學琴，去她的道館開始下一步的學習吧。

source: Vous avez aidé les trois frères, et ils souhaitent vous remercier en personne.
target: 你分別幫助三兄弟完成了各自的難題，現在他們想親自向你道謝……

source: Vous avez aidé une étudiante nommée Ang à trouver le guide d'observation des étoiles dont elle avait besoin. Apparemment, ce guide a une signification particulière pour elle, car il est lié à un pacte entre amies…
target: 你幫助一位名叫安格的學生找到了她需要的觀星指南，這本指南對她來說有著特殊的意義，似乎是關於她和她朋友間的一個約定。

source: Vous avez conclu un accord avec Jin : si l'Académie de Huaxu de Xuanfang a besoin de plus de matériaux médicinaux à l'avenir, elle vous contactera par message pour vous charger de la collecte.
target: 你與矜約定，若玄方城華胥研究院後續仍需藥材，她會通過飛訊聯絡你，委託你前往採集。

source: Vous avez convenu de jouer un duo avec Qingxiao aujourd'hui. Retrouvez-la au pavillon près du Ministère des Armées, elle vous y attend.
target: 你已和清宵約定了會在今日進行合奏。去軍策府附近那座熟悉的亭子吧，她正在等著你。

source: Vous avez croisé un Exilé attaqué par les Tacet Discords. Après avoir constaté vos capacités, il sollicite votre aide.
target: 路遇被殘象圍攻的流放者，在瞭解你的身手後似乎有事需要你幫忙。

source: Vous avez croisé une chercheuse étrange qui tente de parler à des chats via une fonction spéciale de sa borne...
target: 奇怪的研究員正試圖與小貓對話，她的終端似乎有什麼特殊功能……

source: Vous avez décidé de rester en arrière à la fin de ce récit, plaçant votre espoir en Lupa.
target: 你決定留在這個故事的尾聲，將希望交託給露帕。

source: Vous avez découvert d'étranges statues dans les Plaines Dimmr. Elles semblent garder un lourd secret...
target: 你在黯原之上找到了一些奇怪的雕像，它們背後似乎藏著什麼秘密。

source: Vous avez découvert une moto d'expédition dans le défilé de glace... Trouvez un moyen de la ramener à la Voie céleste.
target: 在冰溝中發現了一輛科考摩托……想辦法將它送回聯運椎骨吧。

source: Vous avez entendu un appel au secours à proximité du Port de la ville Guixu et il paraît que vous vous souvenez de cette voix...Allons vérifier ce qui s'est passé.
target: 歸墟港市附近傳來了一陣斷斷續續的呼救聲，聲音似曾相識……總之，去看看怎麼回事吧。

source: Vous avez investi dans la fondation dont Jianji a parlé, mais verrez-vous vraiment les retours qu'il a promis ?
target: 你對簡集所說的基金會進行了投資，但真能拿到他承諾的分潤嗎？

source: Vous avez obtenu un objet étrange de Chenpi, qui a laissé entendre que c'était la clé d'un secret oublié depuis longtemps.
target: 你從陳皮那裡得到了一把奇怪的鑰匙。這把鑰匙似乎能够打開一扇塵封已久的秘密之門。

source: Vous avez obtenu un véhicule. Suivez les instructions du Canal de Marée jusqu'à la Borne d'entraînement pour terminer le tutoriel.
target: 你已經獲得了運具，根據飛訊的指引，去教學終端完成運具駕駛教學吧。

source: Vous avez obtenu une photo du monde d'une peinture transmutatrice. Cela révèle une histoire du passé....
target: 你從聲骸畫的寶藏世界中得到了一張照片，意外揭開了些塵封的往事……

source: Vous avez percé le secret des trois jetons, mais leurs réponses restent cachées derrière une porte énigmatique, révélée par les indices du cadran solaire.
target: 三件信物的意圖與指向均顯，所有謎題的答案，似乎都隱藏在日晷所指向的那扇神秘大門之後。

source: Vous avez refusé d'aider Zhenliu, mais vous avez tout de même accepté de livrer le colis et la liste à leur destination. Allez trouver le destinataire.

source: Vous avez remis un trésor trouvé chez un enfant à S.I.R.E.N.E., et l'analyse a révélé qu'il était lié à un professeur disparu de l'académie. Vous décidez alors de lancer une enquête.
target: 你把從孩子那裡拿到的「寶藏」交給了I.R.I.S.，透過系統分析，這份「寶藏」與一位失蹤的教授有關，你決定調查這件事情。

source: Vous avez rencontré Bjarki, un élève très gentil. Suite à ses recommandations chaleureuses, vous vous intéressez aux différents clubs de l'académie.

source: Vous avez reçu un message des Concierges, quelque chose a dû se passer avec le Somnoire.
target: 你收到了黑色守門人和白色守門人的聯絡，似乎是心之集域中出現了一些新的情況。

target: 你遇到了一個奇怪的機器人，它似乎對這個世界的真相有著相當獨特的見解……

source: You encountered an Exile attacked by Tacet Discords. After witnessing your capabilities, he seeks for you aid.
target: 路遇被殘象圍攻的流放者，在瞭解你的身手後似乎有事需要你幫忙。

source: You encountered an anxious researcher, who requests your help to fight off the Hoochiefs.
target: 你遇到一個焦急的研究員，她想麻煩你幫忙驅逐搗蛋猿。

source: You find a crowd in a peculiar corner of Jinzhou. Why not go and check it out?
target: 似乎有好幾個人聚集在今州的某處，不如去看看情况吧……

source: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you may witness the shooting stars blaze.
target: 你見到了一小團神秘的「小火苗」。若是跟隨這團火苗，也許能看到流星盛放於火中。

source: You find a mysterious "light spark." Follow this little spark, and you might witness the shooting stars blaze.
target: 你見到了一小團神秘的「小火苗」。若是跟隨這團火苗，也許能看到流星盛放於火中。

source: You find another stray cat. Please rescue it and bring it to Xiaoju.
target: 新的流浪貓出現了，請幫小橘拯救流浪貓，並將貓咪交給她撫養吧。

source:
You find yourself caught in a gamble between Brant and the crew, and before you can protest, the title of one-day captain of the Fool's Troupe is thrust upon you.
Are you ready, Captain? Adventure awaits!
target: 你無意捲入布蘭特和船員們的賭局，成為了愚人劇團的一日船長。準備好了嗎，船長？要開始冒險了！

source: You foiled the Fractsidus' vile plans at Mt. Firmament, but their remnant forces are still active near the ruins of Loong's Ridge. Defeat them before they can cause more harm.
target: 雖然漂泊者破壞了殘星會在乘霄山執行的邪惡計畫，但殘星會的殘餘勢力依然盤踞在遊龍脊的遺跡附近。請在他們引發其他混亂前擊敗他們。

source: You get involved in the reconstruction project of the Spacetrek Observatory by helping rebuild Lahai-Roi's route network.
target: 你透過重建拉海洛路網的方式，正式開始協助深空測界台的重建工程……

source: You hand the “treasure” taken from the kids to I.R.I.S. The system analysis reveals it's connected to a missing professor. You decide to look deeper.
target: 你把從孩子那裡拿到的「寶藏」交給了I.R.I.S.，透過系統分析，這份「寶藏」與一位失蹤的教授有關，你決定調查這件事情。

source: You have a new "Lollo Eater" order. Please fulfill it in time.
target: 您有一份新的「嗚嗚代吃」訂單，請及時上門接單~

source: You have a new "Lollo Fixit" order. Please fulfill it in time.
target: 您有一份新的「嗚嗚閃修」訂單，請及時上門接單~

source: You have a new "Lollo Grocery Shopping" order. Please fulfill it in time.
target: 您有一份新的「嗚嗚買菜」訂單，請及時上門接單~

source: You have a new "Lollo Hitman" order. Please fulfill it in time.
target: 您有一份新的「嗚嗚快打」訂單，請及時上門接單~

source: You have a new "Lollo Petter" order. Please fulfill it in time.
target: 您有一份新的「嗚嗚投餵」訂單，請及時上門接單~

source: You have a new "Lollo Take-in" order. Please fulfill it in time.
target: 您有一份新的「嗚嗚外買」訂單，請及時上門接單~

source: You have discovered the three tokens' purpose and directions, but the answers to their riddles are hidden behind a mysterious entrance, which you found with help from the Sundial's hints.
target: 三件信物的意圖與指向均顯，所有謎題的答案，似乎都隱藏在日晷所指向的那扇神秘大門之後。

source: You have received an invitation letter from Wenshu. It mentions that the"Jinzhou Riverside Games" will be held soon. Go to the coordinates enclosed in the letter and have a look.
target: 你收到了一封來自文叔的邀請函，信中提到「今州競渡會」舉辦在即，去信中附上的座標處看看吧？

source: You help Timoteo recover his stolen funds. The incident comes to an end, his sorrow melting away like tears in the snow.
target: 你幫助提摩西取回了被盜的經費，一切似乎都已結束，一如眼淚消逝在冰雪之中。

source: You helped Fratellino resolve all his troubles, and he wants to thank you in person.
target: 你幫助沃德蒂解決了所有麻煩，他想親自向你道謝……

source: You helped Fratello complete all his trials, and he wants to thank you in person.
target: 你幫助沃德爾戈完成了所有修煉，他想親自向你道謝……

source: You helped Fratellone resolve all his troubles, and he wants to thank you in person.
target: 你幫助沃德戈解决了所有麻煩，他想親自向你道謝……

source: You helped a student named Ang recover her stargazing guide. To her, it's more than just a booklet; it carries the weight of a promise she shared with her friends…
target: 你幫助一位名叫安格的學生找到了她需要的觀星指南，這本指南對她來說有著特殊的意義，似乎是關於她和她朋友間的一個約定。

source: You helped the three brothers with their respective troubles, and they want to thank you in person.
target: 你分別幫助三兄弟完成了各自的難題，現在他們想親自向你道謝……

source: You learned from Lingyang about the story of a Jingle Beast. It is said that they once lived in the vicinity of the Violet Banyan in Dim Forest. Why not go and take a look?
target: 從凌陽口中得知了關於「丁零噹啷獸」的故事，據說它們曾在無光之森的紫月榕一帶棲息過，不如去紫月榕附近看看吧？

source: You made an arrangement with Jin: if the Xuanfang Huaxu Academy needs more medicinal materials in the future, she will contact you via message to commission you for the gathering.
target: 你與矜約定，若玄方城華胥研究院後續仍需藥材，她會通過飛訊聯絡你，委託你前往採集。

source: You may catch more than just fish when out at sea...
target: 出海釣魚時，除了魚以外，還有可能釣到一些意外驚喜……

source: You meet Maji from Lollo Logistics in Ragunna. What new campaign is he planning?
target: 你在拉古那遇到了嗚嗚物流的馬計，他似乎帶來了新的企劃？

source: You meet Xiangli Yao again under the Wishing Tree. Yet, this time you share a walk not for others' wishes but for the moon's glory and the bustling lives of people.
target: 祈願樹下，你又一次邂逅了相里要。你們再度同行，卻不為他人的願望，而是迎月色入懷，閑步在煙火人間。

source: You meet Xuanyin again, while the sounds of frog surround you...
target: 你又見到了懸音，四周的蛙聲此起彼伏……

source: You meet Xuanyin again, who is having fun with some puppies...
target: 你又見到了懸音，她正在和狗狗們玩耍……

source: You meet Xuanyin again, who was buried in thoughts...
target: 你又見到了懸音，她陷入了苦惱地沉思……

source: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is observing the doves on the rooftop...
target: 你又見到了懸音，她正在觀察屋簷上的鴿子們……

source: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is spying on a Green Rabbit...
target: 你又見到了懸音，她正在觀察青雜兔……

source: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is spying on the Tetra...
target: 你又見到了懸音，她正在觀察群彩……

source: You meet Xuanyin again. This time, she is trying to talk to a Gray Crested Gull...
target: 你又見到了懸音，她在嘗試和灰冠鷗對話……

source: You meet a strange dual in the Dim Forest. They seem to have peculiar questions for you. Answer their questions correctly, and you might receive some rewards.
target: 在無光之森遇到了奇怪的人，他們有些奇怪的問題問你。保持耐心，回答他們的問題，也許能拿到獎勵……

source: You meet an enthusiastic student named Bjarki. Thanks to his recommendations, you find yourself intrigued by all the different "fan clubs" across the Academy…
target: 你遇到了一個名叫比亞爾基的熱心同學，在他的推薦下，你對學院中的各個「同好會」產生了強烈的興趣……

source: You meet an old lady in the Asphodel Barrens. She gazes at the fleeting frequencies off into the distance in search of a lost companion who can never return...
target: 你在往世花平野附近遇到了一位老人。此刻她正在花海中遙望著遠處徘徊的頻率，等待著回不去的故人……

source: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...
target: 在虹鎮閒逛時偶然見到一位說書老人，聽他講述乘霄山的長生傳說，這時，你注意到身邊有另一位興致盎然的聽眾……

source: You need clearance to activate the Route Constructor and help the Spacetrek Observatory reconstruct the route network. Talk to Chonglin, who is in charge of the route network, and acquire clearance.
target: 啟動造路懸儀，重建路網協助深空測界台重建需要權限，和路網負責人崇林談談獲取權限。

source: You obtained a strange object from Chenpi, who implied it was a key to a long-forgotten secret.
target: 你從陳皮那裡得到了一把奇怪的鑰匙。這把鑰匙似乎能够打開一扇塵封已久的秘密之門。

source: You receive a Pioneer Association Leaflet in your mailbox. Go to Jinzhou Branch and ask Maqi what has happened.
target: 郵箱裡莫名出現了先行公約的宣傳單，請去往先行公約今州分部，找馬琪了解一下情况吧。

source: You receive a WavesLine message asking for help. Check what it's about.
target: 你收到了一條求助飛訊，去看看是誰需要幫助吧。

source: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...
target: 你接到了來自斐林的通訊，似乎是有幾位不願透露姓名之「人」委託他向你發出邀約……

source: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?
target: 你接到安可的通訊，她說有一個非常厲害非常好玩的東西想要和你分享，到底是什麼呢？

source: You receive a mis-sent message: Ronan claims to have witnessed the "miraculous evolution of a Kronapuff" and excitedly invites you to see it…
target: 你收到了一條錯傳的訊息，傳訊人羅南自稱發現了「一隻冠頂鼴雀的進化奇跡」，熱情邀請你前往一同見證……

source: You receive a new message from the Hunter's Den: Please examine the traces left by TDs and track them down.
target: 狩獵者營地傳來新的訊息：請你比對殘象留下的痕跡，找到獵物的去向。

source: You receive an urgent message from Huaxu Academy for emergency support. Head to the designated location for more information.
target: 收到了來自華胥研究所的緊急情况支援通訊，前往通訊中標注的地址查看情况。

source: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.
target: 你接到洛瑟菈的聯絡，她希望你前往教務處商議後續事宜。緋雪會代替忙碌的校長與你見面。

source: You received a WavesLine message from an unknown sender
target: 你收到一條未知聯絡人的飛訊

source: You received a contact from the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers. Something must've happened with the Somnoire.
target: 你收到了黑色守門人和白色守門人的聯絡，似乎是心之集域中出現了一些新的情況。

source: You received a message from the white cat of the Somnoire. Go talk to it in Ragunna City.
target: 收到了來自心之集域的白貓的訊息，去拉古那城找它聊聊吧。

source: You received a message. Talk to Langsheng.
You received an errand from Jinzhou. What? Flour in Ragunna only costs half as much as in Jinzhou?!
target: 你收到了一份來自今州的代購委託單——拉古那的麵粉定價居然只有今州的一半？！

source: You rescue Jianji and discover the whole affair was the work of Exiles who had slipped into Xuanfang Hold. You recover the funds and, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' help, return them to the victims.
target: 你救出了簡集，並發現這起事件是混入玄方城的流放者所為。你追回了資金，並在外事府的協助下將它們還給了受害者。

source: You rescued a weak Aria Mummer near Septimont City. It entrusts you with four Melody Boxes, each carrying a piece of music. What story might they tell?
target: 你在七丘城邊救下了一具即將消散的留聲奏者，它似乎想託你幫它送一些東西。四個鳴奏之匣，四段不同的音樂，指向的究竟是什麼樣的故事？

source: You retrieved a photo from the sphere inside the morph painting, which reveals clues to a hidden past...
target: 你從聲骸畫的寶藏世界中得到了一張照片，意外揭開了些塵封的往事……

source: You return to Ragunna to see whether the aftermath of the Fabricatorium of the Deep reached the people there, but unexpectedly run into Zani in the city. Might as well talk to her to catch up with the situation.
target: 你回到拉古那，想看看隱海試驗場的動盪有沒有波及眾人，卻意外在城中見到了贊妮。既然如此，去與她談談吧。

source: You run into Lenore, an acolyte of the Order, standing next to an Aria Mummer. She seems to be in trouble...
target: 伊諾爾似乎正對著留聲奏者一籌莫展……

source: You run into Lynae in the Screening Room. Did she… skip classes again? Maybe you should ask her yourself.
target: 你在放映廳發現了琳奈，她該不會是又翹課了吧……還是去問問看吧。

source: You see Panhua comforting a crying girl. Maybe go up and ask what happened...
target: 你看到攀花正在安慰一個哭泣的女孩，也許可以去詢問究竟發生了什麼事……

source: You witness a crime at the stroke of midnight. To your surprise, a familiar figure appears at the scene...
target: 你在深夜目擊了一起犯罪事件。令你意外的是，你在犯罪現場遇到了某位熟人……

source: You're now an expert in finding castaway objects. What new and curious discoveries await you in Honami City?
target: 你已經完全熟悉尋找漂流物的流程了。不知道這次又會在穗波市裡發現什麼有趣的東西呢？

source: You've agreed to learn the guqin from Qingxiao. Head to her training hall to begin the next lesson.
target: 你已答應了跟清宵學琴，去她的道館開始下一步的學習吧。

source: You've agreed to play a duet with Qingxiao today. Head to that familiar pavilion near the Ministry of War. She's waiting for you.
target: 你已和清宵約定了會在今日進行合奏。去軍策府附近那座熟悉的亭子吧，她正在等著你。

source: You've caught the attention of a particularly perceptive Terminal assistant. He claims there exists a race track where no one has ever crossed the finish line...
target: 你被一個終端的智慧助理吸引了注意力，他提到了一條無人能抵達終點的賽道……

source: You've collected some "Sonance Caskets". It seems to fall in the interest of the local Relic Merchant Chenpi.
target: 在今州城外意外撿到了名為「聲匣」的古物，聽說今州的尋遺商人陳皮對聲匣頗為了解，不如找他問問情况。

source: You've discovered an expedition motorbike in the ice gorge... Find a way to bring it back to the Starward Riseway.
target: 在冰溝中發現了一輛科考摩托……想辦法將它送回聯運椎骨吧。

source: You've found some peculiar statues in the Dimmr Plains. They seem to be guarding a hidden secret...
target: 你在黯原之上找到了一些奇怪的雕像，它們背後似乎藏著什麼秘密。

source: You've invested in the foundation Jianji spoke of, but will you really see the returns he promised?
target: 你對簡集所說的基金會進行了投資，但真能拿到他承諾的分潤嗎？

source: You've located the missing patrol mech. Head into the wilderness and retrieve it.
target: 你們已經掌握了失蹤機械的行蹤，是時候前往野外，找到這台失蹤的巡行機械了。

source: You've obtained a vehicle. Please follow the WavesLine instructions and go to the Training Terminal to complete vehicle driving tutorial.
target: 你已經獲得了運具，根據飛訊的指引，去教學終端完成運具駕駛教學吧。

source: You've picked up a recording. The wind is howling in your ears, carrying the whispers. Perhaps, the robot nearby holds the key to unravel the continuation of the story.
target: 你拾取了一份無人應答的錄音。風聲在你耳邊呼嘯，人聲在你耳邊傾訴，也許你可以從邊上的小機器人身上找到故事的後續。

source: You've received an invitation to a peculiar shooting party, seemingly related to the damaged robot in Settle Range. Go check it out.
target: 你收到了一個奇怪的射擊派對的邀請，這似乎和落定嶺上損壞的機器人有關，參加看看吧。

source: You've rescued many stray cats. Please go to Xiaoju's Restaurant to see how they are doing.
target: 貓咪救援計畫已成功拯救多隻貓咪，請接受小橘的邀請前往餐飲店吧，去了解一下貓咪們的近況。

source: Your Summer Will Never Wither
Your Terminal has received similar signals again. Maybe the Nexus Beacon can help you decipher the information contained within.
target: 再一次，你收到了那種特殊的訊號。 如果能到大點的中樞信標處，或許就能聽清這次的訊息了吧。

source: Your Terminal has received similar signals again. Maybe the Nexus Beacon can help you decipher the information contained within.
target: 那種特殊的訊號又出現了，如果能到大點的中樞信標處，或許就能聽清這次的訊息了吧。

source: Your Terminal has received vague signals. Maybe the Nexus Beacon can help you decipher the information contained within.
target: 終端似乎接收到什麼特殊的訊號頻段，但其中的訊息模糊不清。 如果能到大點的中樞信標處，或許就能聽清這些特殊的訊息了吧。

source: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...
target: 往時、記憶、夢境……關於自己、關於曾經，你的心中仍有許多疑問。 而冥冥之中，似乎正有一種指引，將你引向遠方，引向一處海上秘地……

source: Your old friend Maji is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan. You guess it... a friend indeed is a friend in need.
target: 你的老朋友馬計三度出山，聲稱帶來了「全新打法」，是的，正如你所想，你的老朋友永遠需要你的幫助。

source: Your old friend Maji swears he's found his break in Septimont with yet another one of his "genius" business ideas. But whether it takes off or crashes depends on your help.
target: 你的老朋友馬計再次在七丘發現了新的商機。不過，這究竟是商機還是危機，就看你是否願意出手相助了。

source: Yuan Niaozhe

Zahira, commerçante royanne et l'un des «Sept mystères de l'Académie Brandétoile», discute avec un chercheur. Ses mains bougent dans l'air, comme si elle lançait un sort… ou concluait une transaction secrète.
target: 被稱作「星炬學院七大不思議」之一的羅伊商人扎希拉似乎正與一名研究員「聊」著什麼。她的雙手在空中不停比劃著，不知是在「施咒」，還是在進行某種神秘的交易……

source: Zahira, eines der „Sieben Großen Mysterien von Sternenfackel“, scheint gerade mit einem Forscher „zu verhandeln“. Ihre lebhaften Handbewegungen lassen keinen Schluss zu, ob sie einen Zauber wirkt oder inmitten eines geheimen Handels feilscht …
target: 被稱作「星炬學院七大不思議」之一的羅伊商人扎希拉似乎正與一名研究員「聊」著什麼。她的雙手在空中不停比劃著，不知是在「施咒」，還是在進行某種神秘的交易……

source: Zahira, one of the "Startorch's Seven Great Mysteries," appears to be "negotiating" with a researcher. Her animated hand gestures give no clue whether she's casting a spell or haggling in some mysterious trade…
target: 被稱作「星炬學院七大不思議」之一的羅伊商人扎希拉似乎正與一名研究員「聊」著什麼。她的雙手在空中不停比劃著，不知是在「施咒」，還是在進行某種神秘的交易……

source: あなたの励ましのおかげで、リーリアは勇気を振り絞り、料理を始めた。時間があれば、この初心者の料理を味わってみよう。
target: 在你的鼓勵下，萊麗婭鼓起勇氣走上了她的廚藝之路。有空就去嚐嚐這位初學者的手藝吧。

source: あなたの協力で学生たちの研究は無事完了した。エムもあなたに感謝を伝えたいようだ。
target: 你幫助學生們完成了研究，而厄姆也想向你表達感謝。

source: あなたの協力もあり、ドキュメンタリー素材の撮影は無事に完了した。
target: 在你的幫助下，紀錄片素材順利拍攝完成。

source: あなたの指導を受け、機傀小隊は無事に実戦試験を突破した。ただ、隊長はまだ伸びしろがあると見ているようだ。
target: 經過你的指導，機傀小隊順利通過了實戰考核，但隊長認為它們仍有進步的空間。

source: あなたは、あるデバイスのスマートアシスタントに気を取られた。彼は、誰もゴールには辿り着けないという、あるコースについて語っていた……
target: 你被一個終端的智慧助理吸引了注意力，他提到了一條無人能抵達終點的賽道……

source: あなたは、グラディエーターの少女ルパとセブン・ヒルズで出会った。
target: 你與角鬥士少女露帕在七丘相遇。

source: あなたは、音骸絵の中の世界で一枚の写真を入手した。それが思いがけず、過去の隠された出来事を解き明かすきっかけとなる……
target: 你從聲骸畫的寶藏世界中得到了一張照片，意外揭開了些塵封的往事……

source: あなたは「小さな炎」を見かけた。ついていけば、焔に咲く流星を目にすることができるかもしれない。
target: 你見到了一小團神秘的「小火苗」。若是跟隨這團火苗，也許能看到流星盛放於火中。

source: あなたはある研究員のホログラム映像に出会った。彼は自慢の「傑作」を体験させてほしいと頼んできた……
target: 你見到了一個研究員的全像影像，他似乎想讓你體驗一下他引以為傲的「傑作」……

source: あなたはこの物語の終幕に残り、希望をルパに託すことを決めた。
target: 你決定留在這個故事的尾聲，將希望交託給露帕。

source: あなたはぬいぐるみたちと雲の上に向かった。不思議な景色が、あなたたちを待っている。
target: 你與布偶們前往了雲層之上，奇妙的風景正在等待著你們發現。

source: あなたはアスポデロスの野の近くで、一人の老人に出会う。彼女は花の海の中で、遠く漂う周波数を見つめ、戻らぬ故人の帰りを静かに待っている……
target: 你在往世花平野附近遇到了一位老人。此刻她正在花海中遙望著遠處徘徊的頻率，等待著回不去的故人……

source: あなたはカルテジアと肩を並べ、観客不在の戦いを繰り広げた。
target: 你似乎與卡提希婭並肩進行了一場無人可見的戰鬥。

source: あなたは不思議なロボットに遭遇する。この世界の真相について、かなり独特な見解を持っているようだ……
target: 你遇到了一個奇怪的機器人，它似乎對這個世界的真相有著相當獨特的見解……

source: あなたは今州からの買い付け依頼書を受け取った――ラグーナの小麦粉の値段は、なんと今州の半額！？
target: 你收到了一份來自今州的代購委託單——拉古那的麵粉定價居然只有今州的一半？！

source:
あなたは今州で出会った休暇中のアンコから誘われて――
物語の始まりだ。アンコの友達として、勇者メェたちと物語の中へ冒険に行かない？
target: 你在今州城內遇到了正在度假的安可，她向你發出邀請——故事就要開始啦，作為安可的好朋友，要和羊咩勇士一起到故事裏去冒險嗎？

source: あなたは今州で苦しそうにしている男を見かけた。その男は、不思議な襲撃事件に遭遇したと主張している……
target: 你在今州遇到了一個看起來很痛苦的男人，而據他所說，他遭遇了一起神秘的襲擊事件……

source: あなたは偶然、トラットリア・マルゲリータでカルロッタと出会った。二人で食事を進めるうちに、“黄金の歌”にまつわる噂が耳に入る。
target: 你前往瑪格烈特餐廳用餐時，偶然遇見了珂萊塔，她邀請著你一同用餐，你們意外地聽見了一則亡靈的傳聞……

source: あなたは崖の近くで、妙な行動をとる女の子を見かける。何かに挑戦している最中のようだ。
target: 懸崖邊，一名舉止怪異的女孩引起了你的注意。她似乎是正在嘗試某種挑戰。

source: あなたは深夜に犯罪事件を目撃した。意外なことに、犯罪現場でとある知り合いに出会った……
target: 你在深夜目擊了一起犯罪事件。令你意外的是，你在犯罪現場遇到了某位熟人……

source: あなたは漂流物の探索手順をすっかり覚えた。今回はどんな面白いものが見つかるだろうか？
target: 你已經完全熟悉尋找漂流物的流程了。不知道這次又會在穗波市裡發現什麼有趣的東西呢？

source: あなたは無事に乗り物を受け取った。メッセージの指示に従い、チュートリアル用デバイスで使い方を学ぼう。
target: 你已經獲得了運具，根據飛訊的指引，去教學終端完成運具駕駛教學吧。

source: あなたは焦っている研究員に出会った。彼は、ディマー・プレーンズで消息を絶ったTARD-Eユニットを探しているようだ……
target: 你遇到了一個焦慮的研究員，他似乎正在尋找一批在黯原失去聯絡的準時寶……

source: あなたは琢山月と機傀の回収に協力すると約束した。もし異常機傀に出遭ったら、先に回収をしてから、発見地点を琢山月に伝えよう……
target: 你與琢山月約定協助回收機傀。若遇到異常機傀，可以先行出手回收，並將發現地點告知琢山月……

source: あなたは矜と約束を交わした。今後、玄方城華胥研究院が薬材を必要とする場合、彼女はメッセージで連絡し、あなたに採集を依頼するだろう。
target: 你與矜約定，若玄方城華胥研究院後續仍需藥材，她會通過飛訊聯絡你，委託你前往採集。

source: あなたは花火より眩しい
あのダヴィデという船長は、やっとゴンドラに乗って空へと飛び立った。しかし、その旅路は果たして思うようになるのだろうか。
target: 那位名為達維德的船長終於乘坐貢多拉駛向了天空，但這段旅程真的能如他所願嗎？

source: あの子は、覚えている
ありがとう、さようなら。もう一人の俺
target: 謝謝，再見，世界上的另一個我

source: ありふれた一日。道を歩いていると、あなたは危険に晒されている若者を見つける……騎士の物語は、こうして始まる。
target: 這是平常的一天，你在路上發現一個年輕人遇到了危險……關於騎士的故事往往是這麼開始的。

source: ある画家が何かの助けを求めているようだ。様子を見に行こう。
target: 無人問津的街頭畫家正在尋求幫助，去看看是什麼情況吧。

source: ある老人が戦友の手向けとして、彼らの墓標に献花したいと思っている。彼の願いを叶えてあげてください。
target: 遙望公墓的老人希望將自己手中的鮮花獻給過去的戰友，請幫忙完成他的心願吧。

source: ある謎めいた仮面被りがリジョリ群島に現れた。その整った身だしなみの裏には、人知れない狂気が潜んでいる……
target: 黎喬利島上出現一位神秘的面具人，衣著體面，卻有著不同於儀表的瘋癲……

source: いざ乗霄へ
いよいよ企画が最終日を迎える。ブブナビのある「隠し機能」が急に持ち出された……
target: 企劃迎來了尾聲，在最後一天，嗚嗚導航的神秘功能竟被加急使用……

source: おや？今日アランナは城内にいないようだ。
target: 嗯？今天阿蘭娜似乎不在城裡？

source: お菓子不足症
お詫びとして、シグリカはあなたにプレゼントを贈りたいそうだ。
target: 西格莉卡想要送給你一個道歉禮物。

source: かくれんぼをしている子供たちに出会った。制限時間内に全員を見つけることができれば、「宝物」をくれるという。あなたは……
target: 你遇見了正在玩捉迷藏的孩子們，他們告訴你，如果在限定時間內能抓到所有人，他們就有份「寶藏」送給你，你決定……

source: かつて嵐の中、一人のキャプテンが一頭のクジラと共に海の底へと沈んだ。今、再び同じ嵐が海に吹き荒れ、あのクジラもまた、その中を泳いでいる……
target: 在風暴中，曾有一位船長和一頭鯨魚一同沉入海底，如今大海上又掀起同樣的風暴，而那鯨魚也游弋其中……

source: かつて蒔いた善意の種が、今は花が咲き、果実が実った。
target: 曾經釋放的善意，如今開花結果。

source: この景色が君の心に留まらんことを
この月明かりといられますように
これ以上アブ大王に好き勝手させないためには、引き続き魔王城を攻略する必要があります。
target: 為了避免布大王再有空搗蛋，需要繼續攻掠魔王城。

source: ご当地飲料
さあ、海へ魚スティックを調達しに行こう！
target: 是時候去海裡整點魚條了！

source:
しばらくして、トゥリアから連絡があった。あなたがかつて救助した二匹のスカージウィングがモンテ・デリミト付近に現れたので、彼女はそこであなたを待っているという……
彼らを長く待たせないように。
target: 一段時間後，圖莉婭向你發來了聯絡。你曾解救的兩隻災蝶龍出現在了分界山附近，而她正在原地等著你……別讓他們等太久了。

source: しばらくすると……
しばらく再建をしていくと、ぬいぐるみビレッジに新しい客が来た……
target: 經過一段時間的修復，布偶村似乎迎來了新客人……

source: しばらく再建をしていくと、ぬいぐるみビレッジに新しい客が来た……タブドッグのようだ……？
target: 經過一段時間的修復，布偶村似乎迎來了新客人……看起來是隻浴缸犬？

source: すごいもの
target: 一個非常非常厲害的東西

source: すでに残鳴は奏で始めている……あなたはその導きに従い、己の過去を探す旅に出る。それは、新たな、未知に満ち溢れる旅になるだろう。
target: 殘鳴已然奏響……跟隨它的指引，你將尋找屬於自己的過往，踏上全新的未知旅程。

source: すべてが落ち着いた後、とある予想外の来客が学園を訪れ、しばらく滞在することになった。
target: 塵埃落定，意料之外的某人短暫駐留在了學院內。

source: すべてのヴォイドストーム協力戦の目標を完了し、S.I.G.M.A.を見つけて報酬を受け取る。
target: 完成所有虛質磁暴協助作戰目標，尋找S.I.G.M.A.先生領取協助作戰獎勵。

source: すべての魚がここに集うのなら……「魚へん」が付いた「鯨」も……
target: 所有的魚都要匯聚到這裡，鯨魚也是「魚」，那麼……

source: すべての魚が一匹に
せっかく時間を作って宴に顔を出した忌炎が、考え込むように音骸を見つめ続けている。彼に話しかけてみよう。
target: 難得忌炎有時間來到宴會，他卻一直在若有所思地盯著聲骸……去和他打個招呼吧。

source: その特別なメッセージを再び受信した。中枢信号塔に行けば、その情報がはっきり聴き取れるようになるかもしれない。
target: 再一次，你收到了那種特殊的訊號。 如果能到大點的中樞信標處，或許就能聽清這次的訊息了吧。

source: その特別なメッセージを再び受信した。中枢信号塔に行けば、その情報がはっきり聴き取れるようになるかもしれない。
target: 那種特殊的訊號又出現了，如果能到大點的中樞信標處，或許就能聽清這次的訊息了吧。

source: そろそろ出発の時だ。最後にエノルともう少し話そう。
target: 是時候離開這裡了，最後再跟伊諾爾聊聊吧。

source: ただの飾りじゃない
ついに、「ベイ」トーヴェンが審査を受ける時が来た。はたして、彼の願いは叶うのだろうか。
target: 終於到了「焙多分」接受金庫考核的時候，不知道它能不能實現自己的心願呢？

source: つかの間の一休み
とあるソノラの近くで、あなたは思い悩んでいる様子の研究員と出会った。どうやら彼は、とても重要な使命を背負っているようだ。
target: 你在一處索諾拉附近遇到了一個愁眉不展的研究員，他似乎背負著某個相當重要的使命……

source: とある漂泊する音の始まり
とある漂泊する音の始まり・上
とある漂泊する音の始まり・下
とある特殊な課題を達成するため、ゼナスは一人でディマー・プレーンズへ向かった……
target: 為了完成一個特殊的課題，澤納斯獨自進入了黯原……

source:
とある神秘的な音骸絵のそばで、あなたは悪夢に囚われた絵師・クラウディアを呼び起こす。
目覚めた彼女は、あなたに絵の中の世界を調べてほしいと頼み、ひとつのお守りを託した。
target:
神秘的聲骸畫旁，你喚醒了陷入噩夢的畫師女孩克勞迪亞。
克勞迪亞請求你幫助調查畫中世界，並將護身符贈與你作為協助。

source: とある謎の扉のそばに、ドロシーという女の子が現れた。彼女によれば、扉の向こう側で突如として危機が発生したらしい。
target: 名為多蘿西的女孩出現在了神秘門扉旁。據她所言，門扉的另一側出現了突如其來的危機。

source: とうに死んだはずのキャプテンに、出航叶わぬ船。そして今、かのキャプテンは必然に至る道を歩み、この船もまた、再び大海へと漕ぎ出す……
target: 一位早已死去的船長，一艘無法啟航的船。而現在，那位船長已經走上必然之路，這艘船，也該再次啟航……

source: どこか不安な予感がする。今回の漂流物捜索は順調にいかないかもしれない。まずは、カフェに様子を見に行こう。
target: 你有不太好的預感，這次的漂流物搜尋或許不會那麼順利。總之，先前往咖啡廳看看吧。

source: なぜか、「ナミポン大家族」は毎回違うナミポンで漂流物の情報を届けてくる。今回現れるのはどのナミポンだろうか。
target: 不知道為什麼，「波仔大家族」每次都會派出一個不同的個體來給你漂流物情報。這次登場的會是哪個波仔呢？

source: なぜか人が集まっているようだ。様子を見に行こう。
target: 似乎有好幾個人聚集在今州的某處，不如去看看情况吧……

source: ぬいぐるみたちの大冒険
ぬいぐるみスクワッド
ぬいぐるみスクワッド、堂々復活！
ぬいぐるみビレッジとの出会い
ぬいぐるみビレッジの再建はやっと終わった。みんながあなたのために小さなパーティーを開催しようとしている。見てみよう。
target: 布偶村的重建工作終於完成了，大家準備了一場小小的派對，期待你的到來！

source: ぬいぐるみビレッジの再建・1期
ぬいぐるみビレッジの再建・2期
ぬいぐるみビレッジの再建・3期
ぬいぐるみビレッジの再建・4期
ぬいぐるみ遠征隊
ねこ探しの達人
またしても、路網付近で流れ者が不穏な動きを見せているという知らせを受け取った。事態はそう単純ではないという予感がする……
target: 又一次，你收到了流民在路網附近蠢蠢欲動的消息，隱約感覺到事情並不簡單……

source: またね！天翔け
また漂流物探しの時間がやってきた。今回一緒に探すのは、ナミポンたちで最も騒がしいあの子のようだ。
target: 又到了尋找漂流物的時間。這次來陪你找漂流物的，好像是波仔們中最聒噪的那個傢伙。

source: また画家から集客のアイデアを考えてほしいと頼まれた。
target: 畫家再次懇求你幫他招攬生意，請配合他完成計畫吧。

source: まだ灯らぬ星へ
まだ食事の約束が果たされていないので、そろそろそれを叶える時だ。今州城に戻ってみないか？
target: 和夥伴的一飯之約還沒兌現，似乎是時候和她好好見上一面了……沒有其他事的話，就回城裡看看吧？

source: みんなの期待に応えるため、シグリカは訓練場で一生懸命訓練をしている。彼女に会いに行こう。
target: 為了回應大家的期望，西格莉卡正在訓練場努力訓練。去見見她吧。

source: もうすぐ月追祭だ。今州に戻ったあなたは願いの木の下にある「月樹屋」の伝説を聞きつけた。そこで、あなたは謎のロボットと出会い、月樹屋の「影のヒーロー」と繋がりを持つようになった......
target: 追月節將近，回到今州的你聽聞了祈願樹下的「月樹屋」傳說，與神秘機器人的相遇將你與月樹屋的幕後英雄，連繫在了一起……

source: もう一度、弾丸を込めて
もし海流瓶を見かけたら、それを調べてみよう。もしかすると、その中に夢と希望が入っているかもしれない。
target: 如果在海上看到了漂流瓶，就去看看吧，也許裡面裝著的正是一份珍藏需求的夢想和希望……

source: ようやく成功した忙しい画家の代わりに、作品を提出してほしいと頼まれた。
target: 走向成功的畫家已無暇分身，他請你幫忙為他遞交作品。
